title: Lautäußerung Kaninchen
author: Fiver, der Hellseher
changes: Pet rabbit honking (soft grunts). Trimmed to 2.55–4.05 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
